entry.name: udpsend
entry.description: Transmits messages over a network using the User Datagram Protocol (UDP).

arguments.name: host
arguments.description: Specifies the host destination to which messages will be sent over a network. Host destinations can be specified either by name (e.g., localhost) or by IP address (e.g., 127.0.0.1).

arguments.name: port
arguments.description: Specifies the remote port that theobject will use when sending messages.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Sends the given message over the network using UDP.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends themessage over the network using UDP.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Sends amessage over the network using UDP.

messages.name: FullPacket
messages.description: Theobject and its counterpart theobject provide support for third-party Max objects that work with the Open Sound Control (OSC) protocol developed by the Center for New Music and Audio Technologies (CNMAT) at the University of California, Berkeley. Themessage toggles support for the 'FullPacket' message used by the CNMAT Open Sound Control externals or the Maxobject--when set, theobject will send UDP buffers in the form of OSC 'FullPacket' messages.

messages.name: host
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies the host destination to which messages will be sent. Host destinations can be specified either by name (e.g., localhost) or by IP address (e.g., 127.0.0.1).

messages.name: int
messages.description: Sends anmessage over the network using UDP.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Sends amessage over the network using UDP.

messages.name: maxpacketsize
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer, sets the size, in bytes, of the largest UDP packet that you can send (default=5096). Since this value is related to the largest Max message you can possibly send, you may need to increase this value if you are sending very long Max messages.

messages.name: maxqueuesize
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer, sets the maximum number of incoming messages that can be in the queue at any given time (default=512). The work queue will grow as needed until this maximum limit is reached. In high-traffic or high-speed situations, you may need to increase the maximum queue size to avoid dropped messages.

messages.name: port
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, specifies the remote port that theobject will use to send outgoing messages.
